action_summary: Add the second closed goal contract to the world broker: env-ready. The broker could already answer run-tests, but every real repository it met needed an environment it did not have, and the refusal that followed was about the environment, not the task. env-ready demands: every dependency the environment declares is present, at a spec-satisfying version, in the isolated interpreter that environment will be asked in, and provable by execution. Host-first: anything the isolation already has costs a metadata read and an import, never a round trip. Otherwise the artifact comes from the machine-readable registry (pypi.org JSON), is hashed by us and compared against the registry's own published digest (two independent readers), installed from local bytes, and read back by import -- not just by version. Transitives are resolved from each verified wheel's own METADATA, marker-filtered, including the project's own extras, which is how requests' SOCKS tests pass. The project installs itself from a staged copy so the tree is never written into. Memory is keyed by the evidence digest and never believed: a warm run re-reads every version and re-imports every module, and a tampered record is caught and re-derived. 24 offline tests; the 9 pre-existing broker tests still green; live receipt on two unseen repositories.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: env-ready is not a new organ: it is the second closed contract on the existing world broker and it composes the existing isolation organ (environment_fit_v1) rather than re-implementing provisioning. A standalone fetch tool, an open-web search tier, npm support and sdist builds were each considered and rejected for this round.

falsification_condition: Falsified if any warm arm returns a version or import state the interpreter contradicts, if any artifact's bytes disagree with the registry's published digest and installation proceeds anyway, or if a repository whose suite passes after arming shows a declared dependency absent. All three are tested; the live tamper case is the standing control.
highest_leverage_note: Two closed contracts either side of a real task now exist in one broker. The next leverage is the same contract shape where the guide is not a manifest at all -- GUI/DOM -- which is blocked in this sandbox (no display) and must be measured elsewhere, not claimed.
honest_limits: Python only. npm/Node arming is not implemented and is not claimed.
Wheels only: an sdist-only release is refused by name; nothing is built from source.
Transitives come from each verified wheel's METADATA and markers, not from a resolver's whole-tree plan; a contradictory sibling constraint would surface as a refusal, not a solve.
Registry reachability depends on the sandbox egress allowlist (pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org, github.com); failures report REFUSE__REGISTRY_UNREACHABLE.
run-tests still assumes the isolated interpreter running pytest; tox/Makefile/non-pytest suites on repositories that need them remain the next bottleneck, measured and named.
Cold arming takes 11.2 s (flask, 14 artifacts) to 27.9 s (requests, 32 artifacts); most of that is registry round trips and pip. No parallel fetch yet.
load_bearing_note: The success probability is a producer estimate for the measurement succeeding (it did), not for any frontier benchmark score moving.

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: No open truth obligation is discharged by this producer-run measurement. It constructs and admits a mechanism -- an environment can now be armed from its own declarations and proven by execution -- and the live receipt shows it on two unseen repositories. Obligation-adjacent, not an obligation move.

measured_effect: Live, on two repositories never brokered before, cloned at pinned commits: pallets/flask 49943b5a9441 armed cold in 11.22 s from 14 verified artifacts, warm in 0.33 s with zero registry requests and zero downloads, then its own suite 494 passed, exit 0. psf/requests 3c7baaa05ab4 armed cold in 27.87 s from 32 verified artifacts, warm in 0.78 s, then 619 passed, exit 0. A tampered memory record on both was caught by the execution re-check (recheck.ok False, from_memory False) and re-derived correctly. Offline: 24 new tests, 33 total across the two broker suites, 0 failures.
next_step: Exercise the same contract shape where nothing declares itself in a manifest: a GUI/DOM surface (OSWorld-shaped), where the environment's declarations must be DERIVED from observation rather than read from pyproject.toml. Blocked in this sandbox: no display, so it routes through a GitHub Actions workflow rather than a local claim.
real_outcome: An environment the system has never seen is now armed from the environment's own declarations with two-reader digest agreement, proven by execution, remembered by evidence, and re-checked on every reuse -- and the other goal can then be asked in it.
